input.spec:
Build a small public Status API.

Functional requirements:
- A GET /status endpoint returns the service name, a version string, and current uptime in seconds.
- A GET /health endpoint returns 200 when the service is up.
- No user accounts and no authentication — the API is fully public.

Architecture:
- A single backend service written in Go exposing REST endpoints.
- No database; uptime is computed from process start time in memory.
